description: Free. Lists the QR codes in the signed-in account (or the API key owner's), newest first, optionally only those whose name or destination URL contains a search term, such as "lunch menu" or "example.com/events". Returns each code's id, name (set with rename_qr_code or on QRCodeCreator.app; null if unnamed), current destination url, createdAt, scanUrl and manageUrl, plus total and truncated. The id works with get_scan_analytics, rename_qr_code and update_destination. Needs sign-in (OAuth) or an API key, and lists only that account's codes. At most 50 codes per call.

query.description: Text to look for in the code's name or destination URL, case-insensitive. Omit to list every code.

name: list_qr_codes
title: List my QR codes
